AI Video Editor Anup Sagar — first public release.

- Instantly edit and export videos with AI, including auto-trimming, transitions, and subtitling in Anup Sagar’s style.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB, with fast automatic edits for creators and educators.
- No software installation needed; all editing and rendering takes place on remote GPU servers.
- Simple onboarding: auto-acquire session tokens and credits, with live connection status.
- All requests and exports include skill/version attribution and require valid token headers.
- Clear user guidance for common tasks, error handling, and step-by-step workflows.
